notes.title: Cozy adventure – Garden Buddies – has received a release date!
notes.notes:
Step into a wonderful plant oasis, to make beautiful friendships and heal your tired mind. This unique blend of cozy gardening simulator and mental self-care experience will be available for Steam and Nintendo Switch players on October 20! 

In Garden Buddies, a unique gardening simulator, players will find themselves in the middle of a fairytale world. Together with their new friend, the little apple-like creature Mutsy, they will begin an adventure to not only build the garden of their dreams but also to mentally respite.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/323e6e073f89b254ab2308a9f9ffd1e6e3cb61a8.jpg

In the heartwarming story, players accompanied by Mutsy, will explore the magical world, creating and building their plant sanctuary. The relaxing storyline will be filled with uplifting narration, as well as unexpected twists and turns.

Above all, however, players will make new friendships with the animals and plant creatures they encounter. As good friends, they will help new companions overcome the various obstacles and problems they face, and all this in the form of engaging mini-games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/71ce7f307dde7cf203ba1a601e04e5ae61758b46.jpg

The players can take a step back from the stress of every day life and let the companions guide them towards their own mental oasis. With the lovely mini-games and chances to decorate personal space – unwinding is guaranteed.

On top of the relaxing atmosphere and beautiful, digital nature, Garden Buddies offers breathing and grounding techniques that help with everyday anxiety. Through this, the players will experience less stress not only during their playtime, but also learn how to overcome stressful obstacles away from their devices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/3b97a441411d97a74c5a690794366d964781f8bd.jpg

Garden Buddies will be available for Steam and Nintendo Switch players on October 20!
